headline: Bully: dog eat dog school
title: Bully Facts | Rockstar School Game | Classic Games
video_script: Bully is a Rockstar Games classic from October seventeenth, twenty oh six, on PlayStation two. You play Jimmy Hopkins, a troublemaker sent to Bullworth Academy, and rise through the school's cliques while attending classes and skateboarding around town. In Europe it was called Canis Canem Edit, Latin for dog eat dog. It sold over one point five million copies. Did you ever play Bully? Comment below!
description: Bully (Rockstar Vancouver, 2006) follows Jimmy Hopkins at Bullworth Academy; sold over 1.5 million copies and was called Canis Canem Edit in PAL regions. Source: Wikipedia.
